name: Breitenhof
beschreibung: The Breitenhof is a hotel in Thiersee in Tirol. The house is located near Lake Thiersee and offers comfortable guest rooms. Meals are usually provided as part of a breakfast or half-board package. Thiersee is particularly known for swimming holidays and hiking in summer. In winter, guests can use the nearby ski area. The hotel is suitable for couples and families.
